# CriticalityEntanglementIndex

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A scalar metric that measures the degree of interdependence between critical slowing-down modes in a Markov dynamical system. Serves as a design heuristic for iNEST reservoirs to tune synaptic coupling strengths toward optimal computational capacity at the edge of chaos.
